assertions.assertion: The claim was for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
The CPT code for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is 93229
The denial was under Reason Code CO-197
Reason Code CO-197 indicates the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness that are concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code I34.0 corresponds to known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code R42 corresponds to dizziness and giddiness
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
